caption: The drawing features a single, clear glass goblet placed centrally on an off-white or light beige background. The goblet consists of a circular base, a short stem, and a rounded bowl with vertical facets and a slightly flared rim that has a scalloped edge. The glass appears transparent, with light reflections and subtle shades of grey, blue, and pink used to suggest its material and form. The composition is minimal, with no additional objects or background details, and the artist's signature appears below and to the right of the goblet.
title: Salt Dip
